title: Chapter 61 — Job-Site Coordination and Delivery
intro: Construction-calendar fluency, site-delivery craft, and coordination.

sections.title: Construction Runs on Schedules
sections.content:
Delivering appliances to a construction site requires different skills than delivering to a home. Site readiness, access restrictions, storage conditions, and installation sequencing all matter.

Coordinate with the builder's site superintendent. Confirm the site is ready before dispatch. Protect products on-site. Schedule installation with the project timeline.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating job-site coordination, ask:

Does the salesperson coordinate with the site superintendent — or just ship and hope?
Are deliveries aligned with the construction schedule?
Is product being protected on-site?
